title: Scary Teacher 3D
description: Sneak, prank, and outsmart Miss T in this suspenseful, humorous 3D puzzle-stealth game. Explore a detailed 3D environment, find clues, and execute creative traps while staying stealthy. Developed at GenITeam Solutions and published by Z&K Games on Steam. Free to play with dynamic challenges across multiple levels.

title: Coin Sort
description: Sort and merge coins to clear the board in this addictive arcade-style puzzle game. Enhance your reflexes and strategy by placing coins into stacks based on color, size, and denomination. Features multiple coin types, power-ups, and progressively challenging levels. Published by Lion Studios. Rated 4.7 stars with 48K ratings on the App Store.

title: Traffic Jam Fever
description: Draw new roads and let more vehicles pass without creating traffic jams. A casual simulation game where you manage traffic flow by drawing routes and keeping vehicles moving. Published by Supersonic Studios with 10M+ downloads on Google Play.

title: Neon Grid Rush
description: Step into a vibrant neon world where every jump depends on timing, focus, and quick reactions. Move forward along a glowing track filled with colorful obstacles and sharp turns in momentum. Tap at the right moment to jump, clear the path ahead, and keep your run going for as long as possible.

title: Shoe Strike!
description: Ready to teach your rude boss a hilarious lesson? Welcome to Shoe Strike!, the funniest office revenge game where every flying sneaker counts! Your boss constantly yells at employees, ruins everyone's day and walks away like nothing happened.

Choose from powerful weapons, tough armor, and strategic gadgets to create the ultimate battle machine. Compete in action-packed arenas, earn rewards, and climb the global leaderboard.
